title: The Mountain Remembers
narrative: Before sunset, the merchant opens the case and the village returns the scale. The village head finally tells the story of the calm creature he saw thirty years ago. The messenger carries the scale back toward the mountain, and the stream begins to run clear. The villagers learn that three centuries of fear grew from a single misunderstanding.
truth_reveal: Nian is a mountain guardian, not a man-eating beast.
The scale was found by the firecracker maker and sold to the merchant.
The village head saw Nian thirty years ago but kept silent.
The messenger came to ask whether the village still remembered the mountain.

character_fates.village_head: Confesses and begins repairing the old misunderstanding.
character_fates.young_scout: Becomes the first young keeper of the true story.
character_fates.firecracker_maker: Admits selling the scale and helps return it.
character_fates.merchant: Gives up the scale and remains welcome in the village.
character_fates.old_hunter: Opens his notebooks and teaches the village to read warnings.

title: A Quiet Repair
narrative: The scale returns to the mountain, but the village head refuses to explain why the old story was wrong. The stream recovers, yet the next generation inherits a half-truth. The immediate danger passes, while the deeper misunderstanding waits for another honest voice.
truth_reveal: Returning the scale restores Nian's strength.
Silence leaves the village vulnerable to repeating the same fear.

character_fates.young_scout: Knows that the public story is incomplete.
character_fates.firecracker_maker: Lives with the burden of the sale.
character_fates.sage: Keeps the old book hidden for a future reader.

title: The Dry Stream
narrative: The scale remains in human hands. The messenger leaves before sunset, and the stream grows thinner through the following weeks. The village has chosen possession over understanding, and the mountain answers with silence.
truth_reveal: The scale was part of Nian's strength.
The villagers had enough evidence to choose another path.

character_fates.village_head: Remains trapped by the silence of thirty years.
character_fates.young_scout: Keeps the hidden letter as a warning.
character_fates.merchant: Keeps the object but loses the village's trust.
character_fates.sage: Records the failure for the next generation.
